task: T15 — Tool-call dispatch with T21 approval gating reuse

scenarios.name: blocked_tool

result.error: tool not available in this build

scenarios.rationale: export_to_image is in EXCALIDRAW_BLOCKED_TOOLS (requires Express front-end Jan does not run). Unknown tools (not in EXCALIDRAW_ALLOWED_TOOLS) get the same envelope — closed allow-list.

scenarios.name: readonly_tool
scenarios.rationale: query_elements is in EXCALIDRAW_READONLY_TOOLS — bypasses approval entirely. Even if approvalGate would resolve false, it is never consulted.

fail_closed.trigger: mutating tool dispatched while deps.approvalGate is undefined

result.error: tool requires approval but no gate configured

fail_closed.rationale: A mutating call with no gate is an installation bug. Surface loudly via logger + telemetry; never silently auto-approve.

wire_marshalling.success_passthrough: content array re-packed (drops extra wire fields like _meta, structured)
wire_marshalling.isError_true: content[0].text becomes the error message; empty content falls back to 'tool returned an error'
wire_marshalling.top_level_error_string: promoted to { error } regardless of isError

type_discipline.return_shape: structurally compatible with McpToolResult discriminated union from ./types.ts
type_discipline.no_widening: extra wire fields are dropped, not forwarded; McpToolResult union remains { content } | { error }
